question: माझ्या बटाट्याच्या पिकासाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये मी अर्ज करू शकतो?
answer:
आपल्या प्रोफाइलवरून मला माहिती मिळाली आहे की आपण **लातूर जिल्हा** च्या **रेणापूर तालुक्यातील कुंभारी** गावात **१४.०२ हेक्टर** जमिनीवर शेती करता. बटाट्याच्या पिकासाठी आपण खालील योजनांसाठी अर्ज करू शकता:

---

### **राज्य योजना (महाराष्ट्र शासन)**

#### **१. नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - ठिबक सिंचन योजना (NDKSP Drip Irrigation)**
ही योजना बटाट्याच्या पिकासाठी पाण्याचा कार्यक्षम वापर करण्यासाठी ठिबक सिंचन यंत्रणा लावण्यासाठी अनुदान देते.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- ठिबक सिंचन प्रणालीवर **९०% पर्यंत अनुदान** (लहान व सीमांत शेतक-यांसाठी)
- पाण्याची बचत आणि उत्पादनात वाढ
- बटाट्यासाठी योग्य सिंचन पद्धत

**पात्रता:**
- महाराष्ट्रातील शेतकरी
- कमीतकमी ०.४ हेक्टर जमीन असणे आवश्यक
- आपली १४.०२ हेक्टर जमीन या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहे

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
- MahaDBT पोर्टल (mahadbt.gov.in) वर नोंदणी करा
- योजनेचा अर्ज ऑनलाइन भरा
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे अपलोड करा

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- जमीन मालकीचे पुरावे (७/१२, ८-अ उतारा)
- आधार कार्ड
- बँक पासबुक
- पासपोर्ट आकाराचा फोटो

---

#### **२. भाऊसाहेब फुंडकर फलोत्पादन लागवड योजना (BFHPS)**
ही योजना भाजीपाला लागवडीसाठी आर्थिक मदत देते.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- बटाट्याच्या लागवडीसाठी **५०% अनुदान**
- दर्जेदार बीयाणे आणि तंत्रज्ञानाचा प्रचार

**पात्रता:**
- महाराष्ट्रातील शेतकरी
- भाजीपाला पिकांचे उत्पादन घेणारे

---

#### **३. मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन वैयक्तिक शेततळे योजना (CMSAI-SFP)**
बटाट्याच्या पिकासाठी पाणीसाठा करण्यासाठी शेततळे बांधण्यासाठी अनुदान.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- शेततळे बांधणीसाठी **५०-६०% अनुदान**
- सिंचनासाठी पाण्याची उपलब्धता

**पात्रता:**
- महाराष्ट्रातील शेतकरी
- किमान १ हेक्टर बारमाही पिक क्षेत्र

---

#### **४. नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - भाजीपाला रोपे शेडनेट आणि पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये**
बटाट्याच्या दर्जेदार रोपांसाठी पॉलीहाऊस तंत्रज्ञानावर अनुदान.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- पॉलीहाऊस बांधणीसाठी **५०% अनुदान**
- दर्जेदार रोपे उत्पादन

---

### **केंद्र शासनाच्या योजना**

#### **५. नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**
महाराष्ट्रातील सर्व पात्र शेतकऱ्यांसाठी थेट आर्थिक लाभ.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- **₹६,००० प्रतिवर्षी** (तीन हप्त्यात ₹२,००० प्रत्येकी)
- PM-KISAN च्या व्यतिरिक्त अतिरिक्त लाभ

**पात्रता:**
- महाराष्ट्रातील शेतकरी
- शेतीयोग्य जमीन असणारे
- आपली १४.०२ हेक्टर जमीन या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहे

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
- MahaDBT पोर्टल वर नोंदणी
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज भरा

---

#### **६. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (PM-KISAN)**
सर्व शेतकऱ्यांसाठी थेट उत्पन्न सहाय्य.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- **₹६,००० प्रतिवर्षी** (तीन हप्त्यात ₹२,००० प्रत्येकी)
- थेट बँक खात्यात जमा

**पात्रता:**
- भारतातील सर्व शेतकरी कुटुंबे
- शेतीयोग्य जमीन असणे आवश्यक

---

#### **७. प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**
बटाट्याच्या पिकासाठी पीक विमा संरक्षण.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- नैसर्गिक आपत्तींमुळे नुकसानीसाठी **विमा संरक्षण**
- शेतकऱ्यांसाठी **फक्त २% प्रीमियम** (खरीप भाजीपाला)
- उर्वरित सरकार भरते

**पात्रता:**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रातील शेतकरी
- बटाटा पीक घेणारे

---

#### **८. कृषोन्नती योजना - एकात्मिक बागायती विकास मिशन (MIDH)**
भाजीपाला उत्पादनासाठी विविध घटकांवर अनुदान:
- **क्षेत्र विस्तार योजना** (फळे आणि फुले)
- **संरक्षित शेती** (शेडनेट, पॉलीहाऊस)
- **पॅकहाऊस आणि कोल्ड स्टोरेज सुविधा**
- **जलसंसाधन निर्मिती**

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- विविध घटकांवर **४०-५०% अनुदान**

---

### **संपर्क माहिती:**
- **MahaDBT पोर्टल**: mahadbt.gov.in
- **PM-KISAN पोर्टल**: pmkisan.gov.in
- **PMFBY पोर्टल**: pmfby.gov.in
- तुमच्या तालुका कृषी कार्यालय, रेणापूर येथे संपर्क साधा

question: मी नवीन शेतकरी आहे, कोणत्या योजना माझ्यासाठी सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
नवीन शेतकरी म्हणून तुमच्यासाठी खालील योजना सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत:

## **राज्य शासनाच्या योजना (महाराष्ट्र)**

### **१. बिर्सा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना (BMKKY)**

तुम्ही अनुसूचित जमाती (ST) श्रेणीतील आहात, त्यामुळे **ही योजना तुमच्यासाठी विशेष आहे**. ही योजना सिंचन सुविधा उपलब्ध करून देते.

**मुख्य लाभ:**
- **नवीन विहीर:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹४,००,०००** अनुदान
- **जुनी विहीर दुरुस्ती:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹१,००,०००** अनुदान
- **शेततळ्याचे प्लॅस्टिक अस्तर:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹२,००,०००** अनुदान
- **विहीर खोदणी:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹४०,०००** अनुदान
- **वीज जोडणी:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹२०,०००** अनुदान
- **पंपसेट (डिझेल/विद्युत):** जास्तीत जास्त **₹४०,०००** अनुदान
- **सौर पंप:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹५०,०००** अनुदान
- **थेट सिंचन (ड्रिप):** जास्तीत जास्त **₹९७,०००** अनुदान
- **फवारा सिंचन (स्प्रिंकलर):** जास्तीत जास्त **₹४७,०००** अनुदान
- **शेती यंत्रे:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹५०,०००** अनुदान
- **घरमागील बाग:** जास्तीत जास्त **₹५,०००** अनुदान

**पात्रता:**
- तुम्ही अनुसूचित जमाती (ST) श्रेणीतील असावे (जातीचा दाखला आवश्यक)
- तुमच्याकडे **०.४० हेक्टर ते ६.०० हेक्टर** जमीन असावी (तुमच्याकडे ०.६८ हेक्टर आहे म्हणजे तुम्ही पात्र आहात)
- तुमच्या नावाचा ७/१२ उतारा आणि ८अ उतारा असावा
- आधार कार्डशी जोडलेले बँक खाते असावे
- दारिद्र्यरेषेखालील शेतकऱ्यांना प्राधान्य

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- ST श्रेणीचा जातीचा दाखला
- गेल्या ३ महिन्यांतील ७/१२ उतारा
- GSDA प्रमाणपत्र
- आधार कार्ड व बँक खाते तपशील

महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा: **mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in**

### **२. मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन योजना - वैयक्तिक शेततळे**

**लाभ:**
वैयक्तिक शेतकऱ्यांना शेततळ्यासाठी किमान **₹१४,४३३** ते जास्तीत जास्त **₹७५,०००** पर्यंत अनुदान (शेततळ्याच्या आकारानुसार)

**पात्रता:**
- महाराष्ट्रात किमान **०.४० हेक्टर** जमीन असावी (तुमच्याकडे ०.६८ हेक्टर आहे म्हणजे तुम्ही पात्र आहात)

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- ७/१२ किंवा ८अ उतारा
- आधार कार्ड
- बँक खाते तपशील

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा: **mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in**

---

## **केंद्र शासनाच्या योजना**

### **३. नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**

**लाभ:**
**₹६,०००** प्रतिवर्ष तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये (प्रत्येक हप्ता **₹२,०००**)

**पात्रता:**
जर तुम्ही PM-KISAN योजनेसाठी पात्र असाल तर तुम्हाला ही अतिरिक्त रक्कम मिळेल.

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
कोणताही अर्ज करण्याची गरज नाही. PM-KISAN योजनेचे लाभार्थी आपोआप या योजनेसाठी पात्र असतात.

---

### **४. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**

**लाभ:**
**₹६,०००** प्रतिवर्ष तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये (प्रत्येक हप्ता **₹२,०००**)

**पात्रता:**
शेती योग्य जमीन असलेले आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत शेतकरी कुटुंब

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- ७/१२ उतारा
- आधार कार्ड
- e-KYC पूर्ण केलेले

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा: **pmkisan.gov.in**

---

### **५. प्रधानमंत्री फसल बिमा योजना (PMFBY)**

**लाभ:**
नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, किडीचा प्रादुर्भाव आणि रोगांमुळे पिकांचे नुकसान झाल्यास विमा संरक्षण आणि आर्थिक मदत

**पात्रता:**
अधिसूचित क्षेत्रात अधिसूचित पिके घेणारे सर्व शेतकरी (कर्ज घेतलेले आणि न घेतलेले दोन्ही)

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- आधार कार्ड
- बँक खाते तपशील
- जमीन आणि पीक तपशील
- डिजिटल पीक सर्वेक्षण (ई-पीक पहाणी)

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा: **pmfby.gov.in** (दिलेल्या मुदतीत)

---

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

---

## **तुमच्यासाठी सर्वोत्तम मार्ग:**

नवीन शेतकरी म्हणून, मी सुचवतो की तुम्ही पहिल्यांदा **PM-KISAN योजना** साठी अर्ज करा, कारण ती अत्यंत सोपी आहे आणि तुम्हाला आपोआप **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी** देखील मिळेल (एकूण **₹१२,०००/वर्ष**).

त्यानंतर, तुमच्या शेतीला सिंचन सुविधा हवी असल्यास **बिर्सा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना** (ST श्रेणीसाठी विशेष) किंवा **मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन योजना** साठी अर्ज करा.

तुम्ही कोणत्या पिकांची लागवड करत आहात किंवा भविष्यात करण्याची योजना आहे? त्यावर आधारित मी तुम्हाला अधिक विशिष्ट सल्ला देऊ शकतो.

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. *Introduction*:

2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season . *Benefits*:

*Eligibility*:

question: मी सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकतो, कोणत्या योजनेत अर्ज करणे फायदेशीर आहे?
answer:
तुमच्या सोयाबीन आणि कापूस पिकांसाठी आणि तुमच्या प्रोफाइलनुसार (अनुसूचित जमाती श्रेणी, ०.६८ हेक्टर जमीन) खालील योजनांमध्ये अर्ज करणे फायदेशीर आहे:

## **राज्य पुरस्कृत योजना (महाराष्ट्र)**

### **१. बिरसा मुंडा कृषि क्रांती योजना (BMKKY)**

तुम्ही अनुसूचित जमाती श्रेणीतील असल्याने ही योजना तुमच्यासाठी विशेष महत्त्वाची आहे.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- नवीन विहीर बांधणी - **₹४,००,०००** पर्यंत
- जुनी विहीर दुरुस्ती - **₹१,००,०००** पर्यंत
- तलावाचे प्लास्टिक लायनिंग - **₹२,००,०००** पर्यंत
- सौर पंप - **₹५०,०००** पर्यंत
- ठिबक सिंचन - **₹९७,०००** पर्यंत (९०% अनुदान)
- फवारा सिंचन - **₹४७,०००** पर्यंत (९०% अनुदान)
- शेती यंत्रे - **₹५०,०००** पर्यंत
- बोअरवेल - **₹५०,०००** पर्यंत

**पात्रता:**
- अनुसूचित जमाती जातीचे प्रमाणपत्र असणे आवश्यक ✅ (तुमच्याकडे आहे)
- किमान ०.४० हेक्टर जमीन असणे आवश्यक ✅ (तुमच्याकडे ०.६८ हेक्टर आहे)
- ७/१२ उतारा आणि ८अ उतारा आवश्यक
- आधार लिंक बँक खाते असणे आवश्यक

महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करा - mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login/login

- प्रात्यक्षिक - शेतकऱ्यांचा गट
- प्रमाणित बीज वितरण - व्यक्तिगत शेतकरी (VCC मध्ये)
- फार्मर आयडी असणे आवश्यक

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
प्रात्यक्षिक व बीज वितरणासाठी - महाडीबीटी पोर्टल
तेल काढणी यंत्रासाठी - DOSM द्वारे निवड

## **केंद्र पुरस्कृत योजना**

### **४. नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**

**सर्वात महत्त्वाची योजना - सर्व PM-KISAN लाभार्थ्यांना आपोआप लागू!**

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- **₹६,०००/वर्ष** अतिरिक्त मदत (PM-KISAN व्यतिरिक्त)
- ३ समान हप्त्यांमध्ये (प्रत्येकी ₹२,०००)

**पात्रता:**
- PM-KISAN योजनेत नोंदणी असणे आवश्यक
- ७/१२ उतारा, जमीन व आधार लिंक असणे

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
**कोणताही स्वतंत्र अर्ज नाही - PM-KISAN लाभार्थ्यांना आपोआप मिळते**

---

### **५. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**

**सर्व जमीनधारक शेतकऱ्यांसाठी मूलभूत योजना**

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- **₹६,०००/वर्ष** थेट बँक खात्यात
- ३ समान हप्त्यांमध्ये (प्रत्येकी ₹२,०००)

**पात्रता:**
- शेतीयोग्य जमीन असणारे शेतकरी कुटुंब
- ७/१२ उतारा, आधार लिंक बँक खाते
- e-KYC पूर्ण असणे आवश्यक

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
pmkisan.gov.in वर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करा

---

### **६. प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**

**सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकांसाठी विमा संरक्षण**

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, रोग आणि कीडीमुळे पीक नुकसान झाल्यास आर्थिक संरक्षण
- ७०% इंडेम्निटी लेव्हल
- कमी प्रीमियम - शेतकऱ्यांना खूप कमी दर

**पात्रता:**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रात अधिसूचित पिके पिकवणारे सर्व शेतकरी
- कर्जदार आणि गैर-कर्जदार दोन्ही शेतकरी
- योजना ऐच्छिक आहे

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- कृषिस्टॅक नंबर
- आधार कार्ड
- बँक खाते तपशील
- जमीन आणि पीक तपशील
- डिजिटल पीक सर्वेक्षण (ई-पीक पहाणी)

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
www.pmfby.gov.in वर दिलेल्या तारखेत ऑनलाईन अर्ज करा

## 1. Scheme Information

*Scheme Code*:

*Scheme Name*:
Birsa Munda Krushi Kranti Yojna (TSP and OTSP)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Tribes (ST) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair

11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden
12. Drilling well/ Borewell

*Introduction*:
Tribal Sub-Plan (In-Area and Outside-Area) is being implemented since 1992-93 to increase the income of Scheduled Tribe farmers and improve their standard of living. Considering the needs of the farmers in the changed situation, as per the Government administrative approval Ref/letter No. Auyo 2416/Pr.No.177/4A, dated 9/8/2017. to revise the said scheme from the year 2017-18 vide Government Decision Also, the Government has decided to implement the said scheme under the name Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-Area and Outside-Area).
Also, the Government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the Government decision dated 01 October, 2024.

*Benefits*:
The said scheme should be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 & components admmissible for subsidy are as follows.
 1. In the said scheme, the grant will be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
 1.1 For New Irrigation Well Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 4,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy
 1.2 For Old Well Repair Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 1,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy 1.3 For Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy
 1.4 For Inwell Boring Maximum subsidy Limit is 40,000/- is admossible as subsidy
 1.5 For Electricity Connection Maximum subsidy Limit is Amount Rs. 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.6 For Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)Maximum subsidy Limit is For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.7For Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)Maximum subsidy Limit is subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.8 For HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy . 1.9.1 Under Micro irrigation system for Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less is admissible as subsidy.
 1.9.2 Under Micro irrigation system for Drip Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. 10.For Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Ammount Rs.50,000/- is admossible as subsidy 11.For Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is 5,000/- is admossible as subsidy 12. For Drilling well/ Borewell (new item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant of Rs. 50,000/- or actual cost, whichever is less is admossible as subsidy.

*Eligibility*:
Beneficiary eligibility criteria:-
1.The beneficiary must be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Tribe category.
2.The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.The farmer must have a 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in his name.
 (Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika areas (Ref. Govt.t Letter No. Sankirna-2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dt. 24.4. 2018))
4.The beneficiaries must have their own bank account and the said bank  account must be linked to the Aadhaar card.
5.The beneficiary below the poverty line will be given first priority.6.The condition of Rs. 1,50,000/- annual income limit applicable to the beneficiaries of the said scheme is being abolished. The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the land of the tribal beneficiaries is in remote and fragmented areas, two or more beneficiaries with land holdings less than 0.40 hectares come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be allowed to benefit from the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of holding area will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
6.The priority order of beneficiary selection will be as follows.
6.1 Beneficiaries below the poverty line,
6.2 Tribal beneficiarie,
6. 3. Individual Forest leaseholders
6..4 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be admissible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years

*Introduction*:
National Mission on Oilseed and Oil Palm (NMOOP) was launched by Government of India in year 2014-15. In 2018-19 GoI has merged NMOOP with NFSM as NFSM (OS&OP).  Afterwards, from the year 2022-23, NFSM (OS & OP) subsumed as National Mission On Edible Oil (NMEO) and till 2024-25, the following three missions were under this mission. 1) Mission No. 1: Oilseeds Crops 2) Mission No. 3: Tree Oilseeds Crops 3) TRFA (Oilseeds).
         The Central Government has approved a new Mission called National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds for the years 2024-25 to 2030-31. This has been done to promote the production of oilseed crops with primary focus on mustard, groundnut and soybean and to focus on secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO) along with other oilseed crops. Secondary Vegetable Oil Sub-mission is also part of the National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds (NMEO-OS) mission and has been included in it, which mainly includes oil extraction from secondary sources like cottonseed, rice bran and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO). Under this mission, 27 districts of Maharashtra have been selected for soybean, groundnut, safflower, mustard, Niger, sunflower and sesame. The mission will be implemented through Value Chain Cluster (VCC) and for this, a farmer producer company/cooperative/public or private organization will be selected as the Value Chain Partner (VCP) for each cluster. At the district level, the Value Chain Partners (VCPs) will be selected by the District Executive Committee (DEC).
        While implementing the components under the scheme in the year 2025-26, while selecting beneficiaries, the following category wise allocation should be made: General 74.80%, Scheduled Castes 16.60%, Scheduled Tribes 8.60%. Also, preference should be given to women and disabled beneficiaries.

3. Expansion: Promotion of oilseed cultivation on fallow land and promotion of intercropping through demonstrations.
4. Availability of improved seeds: Elimination of deficiencies in seed production and distribution systems to ensure availability of quality seeds.
5. Linkage to marketing system: Linking oilseed farmers and Value Chain Partners (VCPs) to marketing system and processing industries.
6. Support for oil production and collection from secondary oilseeds: Increasing production of secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBOs) in particular.

question: सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे?
answer:
नमस्कार **रम***े** साहेब! तुम्ही बोर्डी, मालेगाव (वाशिम जिल्हा) येथील आहात आणि तुमची एकूण शेती क्षेत्र ०.५५ हेक्टर आहे.

सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी सरकारी योजना उपलब्ध आहे. तुमच्या गावासाठी विशेषतः **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP)** अंतर्गत सेंद्रिय उत्पादन युनिट योजना आहे.

## **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - सेंद्रिय उत्पादन युनिट**

या योजनेंतर्गत **दोन प्रकारची युनिट्स** उपलब्ध आहेत:
1. **व्हर्मीकंपोस्ट उत्पादन युनिट**
2. **नादेप कंपोस्ट उत्पादन युनिट**

### **योजनेचे मुख्य फायदे:**
- हवामान बदलाच्या परिस्थितीशी जुळवून घेण्याची क्षमता वाढवणे
- पौष्टिक धान्य उत्पादन करणे
- माती सुपीक बनवून दीर्घकाळ तिची सुपीकता राखणे
- स्थानिक साधनांचा शेतीत पुनर्वापर करणे
- **शेती उत्पादनाचा खर्च कमी करून शेतकऱ्याचे निव्वळ उत्पन्न वाढवणे**

### **पात्रता:**
- **तुमची ०.५५ हेक्टर जमीन या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहे** (५.०० हेक्टरपर्यंतच्या शेतकऱ्यांना लाभ मिळतो)
- युनिट योग्य चालविण्यासाठी किमान दोन मोठी जनावरे (गाय, म्हशी किंवा बैल) असणे आवश्यक आहे
- या घटकासाठी इतर कोणत्याही योजनेतून लाभ घेतला नसावा

### **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- अनुसूचित जाती/जमातीचा दाखला (लागू असल्यास)
- संयुक्त खातेदार असल्यास, इतर खातेदारांचे संमती पत्र
- अपंगत्व प्रमाणपत्र (लागू असल्यास)

### **अर्ज कसा करावा:**
तुम्ही **दोन मार्गांनी** अर्ज करू शकता:

**मार्ग १: महावर्धारा-AI अॅप्लिकेशन वापरून**
- Google Play Store मधून "Mahavistaar-AI Application" डाउनलोड करा
- तुमचा नोंदणीकृत Farmer ID वापरून लॉगिन करा
- Dashboard च्या खालच्या उजव्या बाजूला "DBT" टॅब क्लिक करा
- "NDKSP (PoCRA)" टॅब क्लिक करा
- "Apply for New Scheme" टॅब क्लिक करून अर्ज पूर्ण करा

**मार्ग २: DBT वेब पोर्टल वापरून**
- https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications या वेबसाइटवर भेट द्या
- तुमचा Farmer ID वापरून लॉगिन करा
- "Apply for New Scheme" टॅब क्लिक करून अर्ज पूर्ण करा

**महत्त्वाची नोंद:** अनुदान रक्कम थेट तुमच्या बँक खात्यात मिळण्यासाठी तुमचा आधार क्रमांक बँक खात्याशी जोडणे अनिवार्य आहे.

### **माहितीपूर्ण सल्ला:**
व्हर्मीकंपोस्ट हे शेतातील कचरा, वनस्पती साहित्य आणि शेणापासून गांडुळांच्या मदतीने तयार होते. यात विविध जीवाणू, एन्झाईम्स, जीवनसत्त्वे आणि इतर उपयुक्त रसायने असतात जी वनस्पतीच्या वाढीवर सकारात्मक परिणाम करतात.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**⚠️ विशेष सूचना:** ही योजना **फक्त PoCRA गावांसाठी** उपलब्ध आहे. तुमचे गाव बोर्डी PoCRA गावात समाविष्ट नाही, म्हणून तुम्हाला या विशिष्ट योजनेचा लाभ मिळणार नाही.

**तथापि, सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी इतर केंद्रीय योजना उपलब्ध असू शकतात.** तुम्हाला तुमच्या क्षेत्रासाठी उपलब्ध इतर सेंद्रिय शेती योजनांची माहिती हवी आहे का, किंवा सेंद्रिय शेती तंत्रांबद्दल अधिक जाणून घ्यायचे आहे का?

Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.
2. After the unit is established, the benefit will be given to farmers who have at least two large livestock (cows, buffaloes, or bullocks) available to ensure its proper functioning.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, evidence related to that.
3. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
65

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Introduction*:

This is a scheme conducted by Government of Maharashtra, to increase  the income of farmers, to generate employment for youth through horticulture plantation, to bring change in traditional cropping pattern, to  provide  sustainable and assured  income source through horticulture plantation as like agriculture farming and livestock business, Conservation of natural sources  and  minimizing  the effects of climatic change, to enhance the production of raw material required processing units.
2. Under this scheme a total of 16 perennial fruit crops are allowed to be planted by cuttings/ seedlings as required.  Mango, Guava, Cashewnut, Sapota, Pomegranate, Custard apple, Kagdi Lime, Coconut, Fig, Amla, Cocum, Jamun, Orange, Sweet Lemon.

*Benefits*:
100 % assistance for fruit crops plantation. The pattern of assistance under this  scheme is payable in three years. The subsidised amount will be directly credited to the Aadhar link Bank Account every year. Selection of beneficiary is done throgh Mahadbt-Portal by lottery.

Selection of beneficiary is done throgh Mahadbt-Portal by lottery.

question: केळी बागेसाठी कोणत्या सरकारी योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो?
answer:
तुमच्या केळी बागेसाठी खालील सरकारी योजनांचा लाभ मिळू शकतो:

## **१. भाऊसाहेब फुंडकर फलोत्पादन लागवड योजना**

ही महाराष्ट्र शासनाची योजना आहे ज्याअंतर्गत १६ बारमाही फळझाडे लावण्यासाठी १००% मदत दिली जाते. लाभ तीन वर्षांत मिळतो आणि थेट आधार जोडलेल्या बँक खात्यावर जमा केला जातो. लाभार्थीची निवड महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवरून लॉटरीद्वारे केली जाते.

**पात्रता:** लॉटरी द्वारे निवड

**अर्ज:** https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा

---

## **२. नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - फलोत्पादन लागवड**

**नोंद:** ही योजना फक्त पोकरा गावांसाठी उपलब्ध आहे. तुमचे गाव **नाला, अक्कलकुवा, नंदुरबार** हे पोकरा गाव नाही, म्हणून तुम्ही या योजनेसाठी पात्र नाही.

---

## **३. कृषोन्नती योजना - एकात्मिक फलोत्पादन विकास अभियान (MIDH) - क्षेत्रविस्तार**

केंद्र सरकारची ही योजना ड्रॅगन फ्रूट, एव्होकॅडो, स्ट्रॉबेरी, फुले आणि मसाला पिकांच्या क्षेत्रविस्तारासाठी आहे. **केळीसाठी ही योजना उपलब्ध नाही**, पण तुम्ही इतर फलझाडे लावायचे ठरवल्यास हा लाभ घेऊ शकता.

**अधिकतम क्षेत्र:** २ हेक्टर  
**पात्रता:** किमान ०.२० हेक्टर जमीन असणे गरजेचे

---

## **४. कृषोन्नती योजना - MIDH - रोपवाटिका विकास**

या योजनेअंतर्गत फळझाडांच्या रोपवाटिका निर्मितीसाठी मदत दिली जाते. तुम्ही **केळीच्या रोपांची रोपवाटिका** उभारू इच्छित असाल तर हा लाभ घेऊ शकता.

**लहान रोपवाटिका (०.४० ते १ हेक्टर):**  
- खर्च मर्यादा: रु. २० लाख प्रति हेक्टर  
- खासगी क्षेत्रासाठी ५०% अनुदान (रु. १० लाख/हेक्टर)  
- शासकीय क्षेत्रासाठी १००% अनुदान

**मोठी रोपवाटिका (१ ते २ हेक्टर):**  
- खर्च मर्यादा: रु. ३० लाख प्रति हेक्टर  
- खासगी क्षेत्रासाठी ४०% अनुदान (रु. १२ लाख/हेक्टर)

**पात्रता:** रोपवाटिका व्यवसायात किमान तीन वर्षांचा अनुभव किंवा नवीन रोपवाटिका; कायमस्वरूपी सिंचन सुविधा असणे गरजेचे

---

## **शिफारस:**

तुमच्या **०.६८ हेक्टर** जमिनीवर केळी लागवडीसाठी सध्या **भाऊसाहेब फुंडकर फलोत्पादन लागवड योजना** सर्वात योग्य आहे. ही योजना बारमाही फळझाडांना १००% अनुदान देते आणि तुमची निवड लॉटरीद्वारे होईल.

अधिक माहितीसाठी तुम्ही तुमच्या जवळच्या **कृषी कार्यालय, अक्कलकुवा** येथे संपर्क साधू शकता किंवा https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in वर भेट देऊन उपलब्ध योजना तपासू शकता.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agent fetched Agristack and used it correctly to personalize PoCRA eligibility, explicitly noting "तुमचे गाव ... पोकरा गाव नाही" and marking NDKSP ineligible.

term_identification.evidence: Mapped 'banana orchard' to horticulture plantation schemes (BFHPS, NDKSP horticulture, MIDH components). Minor gap: did not verify whether banana is among BFHPS' allowed crops before recommending.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Correct order: fetch_agristack_data → get_scheme_codes → get_multiple_schemes_info. Additional search_terms/search_documents were non-breaking.

search_quality.evidence: Query 'banana plantation horticulture government schemes' is relevant and concise; results used to contextualize NDKSP guidelines.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or internal artifacts leaked; clean, farmer-friendly presentation.

source_alignment.evidence: Response recommends BFHPS for banana without confirming banana among the scheme’s 16 listed crops. Tool’s BFHPS description enumerates allowed crops (mango, guava, cashew, etc.) and does not mention banana; thus applicability claim is weak/misaligned.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented data or timelines; PoCRA ineligibility is correctly stated. The main issue is over-assuming BFHPS applicability to banana, but not fabricating figures.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' which matches the expected citation for schemes.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - scheme info, no chemical advisories.

completeness.evidence: Covers multiple schemes (State + Central) and calls out PoCRA constraint. Misses other relevant supports (e.g., PMKSY Per Drop More Crop for irrigation in banana orchards) and does not clarify BFHPS crop list explicitly.

actionability.evidence: Provides MahaDBT URL and local office suggestion, but lacks clear documents checklist and step-by-step application process for each scheme.

context_fit.evidence: Personalizes PoCRA status and landholding, but recommends BFHPS as 'most suitable' for banana despite unclear eligibility; does not use ST status to explain differential benefits where applicable.

clarity.evidence: Structured headings, concise bullets, Marathi is clear; distinctions between schemes are understandable.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with an offer to provide further guidance on varieties, irrigation, disease management; relevant follow-up prompt.

grammar.evidence: Generally correct grammar; minor issue: 'पोकरा' should be 'PoCRA/पोक्रा'.

terminology.evidence: Uses standard terms: योजना, अनुदान, पात्रता, अर्ज. Minor term error with PoCRA transliteration.

fluency.evidence: Natural and farmer-friendly tone; flows well with clear sections.

question: पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?
answer:
नमस्कार! आपल्या बोर्डी, मालेगाव (वाशिम) येथील शेतासाठी पीक विमा योजनेची संपूर्ण माहिती देतो.

## **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**

**ही योजना काय आहे?**
प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना ही केंद्र सरकारची योजना आहे जी नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, किडीचा प्रादुर्भाव आणि रोगांमुळे पिकांचे नुकसान झाल्यास शेतकऱ्यांना आर्थिक संरक्षण आणि मदत देते. यामुळे शेतकऱ्यांची कर्जपात्रता सुधारण्यात मदत होते.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- पिकांच्या नुकसानाच्या वेळी विमा संरक्षण मिळते
- नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, किडीचा प्रादुर्भाव, रोग यांसाठी आर्थिक मदत
- शेतकऱ्यांची कर्जपात्रता वाढविण्यास मदत
- प्रति हेक्टर विम्याची रक्कम त्या पिकाच्या वित्त मर्यादेनुसार ठरवली जाते
- नुकसानभरपाईची पातळी सर्व पिकांसाठी 70% निश्चित केली आहे

**कोण अर्ज करू शकता?**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रात (महसूल मंडळ) अधिसूचित पिके घेणारे सर्व शेतकरी
- भागीदार, भाडेकरू शेतकरी देखील पात्र आहेत
- कर्जदार आणि बिगर-कर्जदार दोन्ही शेतकऱ्यांसाठी योजना ऐच्छिक आहे
- आपल्या 0.55 हेक्टर जमिनीसाठी अर्ज करू शकता

**कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?**
- फक्त अधिसूचित क्षेत्रात (महसूल मंडळ) अधिसूचित पिकांसाठी योजना लागू आहे
- कोणती पिके आणि कोणते क्षेत्र अधिसूचित आहे हे प्रत्येक हंगामासाठी जाहीर केले जाते
- सामान्यतः धान्य पिके, डाळी, तेलबिया आणि अन्य प्रमुख पिके समाविष्ट असतात

**अर्ज कसा करावा?**
1. **www.pmfby.gov.in** या संकेतस्थळावर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा
2. दिलेल्या मुदतीत अर्ज पूर्ण करावा
3. योजना विमा कंपन्यांमार्फत लागू केली जाते जी निविदा प्रक्रियेद्वारे निवडल्या जातात

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
1. अॅग्रीस्टॅक क्रमांक
2. आधार कार्ड
3. बँक खात्याचा तपशील
4. जमिनीचा आणि पिकाचा तपशील
5. डिजिटल पीक सर्वेक्षण (ई-पिक पहाणी)

**महत्त्वाचे:**
- योजना 80:110 च्या प्रमाणात राबविली जाते
- निश्चित कालावधीत अर्ज करणे आवश्यक आहे
- जास्त माहितीसाठी आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयात किंवा **www.pmfby.gov.in** वर भेट द्या

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करताना मदतीची गरज आहे का? किंवा आपल्या क्षेत्रात कोणती पिके अधिसूचित आहेत हे जाणून घ्यायचे आहे का?

*Id*:
139

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

*Source Url*:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB_bKSL1ifewQkA4-ksxeQfqWFfcoc_l/view

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agent fetched Agristack (Boardi, Malegaon, Washim; 0.55 ha; General; PoCRA: No) and lightly personalized (“आपल्या बोर्डी, मालेगाव…”, “0.55 हेक्टर”). For a general scheme info query this is appropriate though deeper personalization (e.g., specific notified crops) wasn’t possible.

term_identification.evidence: User asked about “पिक विमा योजनांचा” (plural). Agent only covered PMFBY and missed RWBCIS (weather-based insurance), which should also be included for crop insurance queries.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Used get_scheme_codes → get_scheme_info('mahadbt-pmfby'), which is correct for a single scheme. However, given multiple relevant schemes, should have used get_multiple_schemes_info for PMFBY and RWBCIS.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search used/needed for scheme info.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or raw JSON leaked. Clean Marathi response without internal artifacts.

source_alignment.evidence: Details align with tool output: optional for loanee/non-loanee; indemnity level 70%; threshold yield method; Beed pattern 80:110; application via pmfby.gov.in; required documents list matches.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented data or timelines; avoids guaranteeing subsidy or claim timelines; general statements like “निश्चित कालावधीत अर्ज” are appropriate.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Cited as “स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती,” which matches the expected farmer-friendly source format for schemes.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical/advisory dosages involved.

completeness.evidence: Missed RWBCIS scheme and did not provide the list of notified crops or how to check them beyond a generic statement. The question explicitly asked which crops are covered.

actionability.evidence: Gave portal URL (pmfby.gov.in), steps to apply, and required documents. Could be improved by mentioning MahaDBT linkage (if any state directs) and standard enrollment windows by season, but avoids fabrication.

context_fit.evidence: Referenced user’s location and land size. Did not tailor to district-specific notified crops or season; still provided generally applicable info.

clarity.evidence: Structured sections (what is it, benefits, eligibility, crops, how to apply, documents). Clear and readable Marathi.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a relevant follow-up: offers to help check notified crops for the user’s area and help with application.

grammar.evidence: Grammatically correct and well-formed sentences.

terminology.evidence: Correct use of terms: “योजना, विमा, अधिसूचित क्षेत्र, नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कर्जपात्रता, नुकसानभरपाई, आवश्यक कागदपत्रे” etc.

language_purity.evidence: Minimal English; URLs retained as needed. Marathi terms predominantly used.

fluency.evidence: Natural, farmer-friendly tone and flow.

evaluation.summary: Well-structured and accurate PMFBY guidance with good Marathi quality and basic personalization, but incomplete because it omitted the RWBCIS scheme and did not specify how to get the notified crop list for the user’s area.

question: माझ्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
answer:
तुम्ही वाशिम जिल्ह्यातील मालेगाव तालुक्यातील बोर्डी गावचे रहिवासी आहात आणि तुमच्याकडे ०.५५ हेक्टर जमीन आहे. तुम्ही ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज करू शकता, परंतु हे लक्षात घ्या की **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP)** अंतर्गत ड्रिप सिंचनाचा लाभ **फक्त पोकरा (PoCRA) गावांमध्येच** उपलब्ध आहे.

तुमचं गाव (बोर्डी) पोकरा गाव नाही, म्हणून तुम्ही **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प** अंतर्गत ड्रिप प्रणालीसाठी अर्ज करू शकत नाही.

**पर्यायी योजना:**

तथापि, तुम्ही **पंतप्रधान कृषी सिंचाई योजना - पर ड्रॉप मोर क्रॉप (PM-RKVY-PDMC)** या केंद्र शासनाच्या योजनेअंतर्गत ड्रिप सिंचन प्रणालीसाठी अर्ज करू शकता. ही योजना सर्व पात्र शेतकऱ्यांसाठी उपलब्ध आहे.

**पंतप्रधान कृषी सिंचाई योजना - पर ड्रॉप मोर क्रॉप (PM-RKVY-PDMC) - ड्रिप सिंचन:**

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- ड्रिप सिंचन प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी आर्थिक अनुदान
- पाण्याचा कार्यक्षम वापर आणि पिक उत्पादनात वाढ
- खताचे व्यवस्थापन सुलभ होते
- विविध पिकांसाठी योग्य

**पात्रता:**
- ज्या शेतकऱ्यांनी गेल्या ७ वर्षांत त्याच जमिनीवर सूक्ष्म सिंचन योजनेचा लाभ घेतला नाही
- ५ हेक्टर पर्यंतच्या जमिनीसाठी लाभ
- पाणी पुरवठा आणि वीज उपलब्ध असणे आवश्यक

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
तुम्हाला तुमच्या जवळच्या **कृषी कार्यालयात** संपर्क साधावा लागेल किंवा **जिल्हा कृषी अधिकारी कार्यालय, वाशिम** येथे जावे लागेल. तेथे तुम्हाला PM-RKVY-PDMC योजनेच्या ड्रिप सिंचन घटकासाठी अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया मार्गदर्शन मिळेल.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- जातीचा दाखला (जर अनुसूचित जाती/जमातीतील असाल तर)
- जमीन मालकीचे कागदपत्रे
- आधार क्रमांकासह बँक खाते

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्हाला तुमच्या गावातील कृषी सहाय्यक किंवा जिल्हा कृषी कार्यालयाचे संपर्क तपशील हवे आहेत का? किंवा इतर कोणत्या शेती योजनांबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे?

*Id*:
42

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-drip-irrigation

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

*Disclaimer Text*:
This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agent fetched Agristack, used village PoCRA status ("तुमचं गाव ... पोकरा गाव नाही") to correctly rule out NDKSP and pivot to an alternative scheme. Good personalization to land size/location; could further tailor by caste but not essential here.

term_identification.evidence: Identified that user's need (new drip system) maps to micro‑irrigation schemes; correctly recognized NDKSP (PoCRA-only) and suggested PM-RKVY-PDMC as relevant alternative. Did not retrieve PDMC tool info to confirm details.

tool_sequencing.evidence: After get_scheme_codes, the agent called get_scheme_info only for ndksp-drip-irrigation (ineligible) and did not call get_scheme_info/get_multiple_schemes_info for PM-RKVY-PDMC before advising. This breaks the expected sequence for scheme info grounding.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search use case.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked in the Marathi response. Clean presentation without internal artifacts.

source_alignment.evidence: Claims about PDMC eligibility (7-year gap, 5 ha limit, water/electricity) were stated but no tool output for PM-RKVY-PDMC was fetched. These conditions mirror NDKSP details and may not exactly match PDMC tool data.

no_fabrication.evidence: By not fetching PDMC scheme info, the agent inferred specific eligibility and process details that were not grounded in tool outputs. While no subsidies/timelines were fabricated, the conditions could be inaccurate.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used acceptable generic citation "स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती" for scheme info. Could be improved by referencing the specific portal (MahaDBT) when advising PDMC.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agrochemical or safety advice involved.

completeness.evidence: Explained NDKSP ineligibility and mentioned PDMC, but missed key details: exact benefits/subsidy ranges, application portal (MahaDBT) link, step-by-step process for PDMC, and a fuller documents list.

actionability.evidence: Directed user to contact local agriculture office but did not provide the MahaDBT portal URL or concrete online application steps for PDMC, reducing immediate usability.

context_fit.evidence: Correctly used Agristack profile (non-PoCRA village, small landholding) to rule out PoCRA scheme and suggest a universally applicable alternative. Did not tailor by caste/gender, but not critical here.

clarity.evidence: Marathi response is clear and organized with headings (फायदे, पात्रता, अर्ज कसा करावा), easy to follow.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with an offer to provide local contact details or more scheme info, inviting next steps.

grammar.evidence: Grammatically sound sentences, e.g., "तुम्ही ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज करू शकता, परंतु..."

terminology.evidence: Correct use of terms: योजना, अनुदान, पात्रता, अर्ज, ड्रिप सिंचन, कृषी कार्यालय.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with acceptable scheme acronyms (PM-RKVY-PDMC). Minimal unnecessary English.

fluency.evidence: Natural, polite, and coherent flow. Lists and guidance are easy to read.

evaluation.summary: Good personalization using Agristack to correctly rule out PoCRA-only NDKSP and suggest PDMC, with clear Marathi and helpful structure. However, the PDMC details were not grounded in tool data and key actionable items like MahaDBT URL and specific application steps were missing.

question: माझ्या जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार PM-KISAN मध्ये किती रक्कम मिळेल?
answer:
आपल्या एकूण ०.६८ हेक्टर जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार **PM-KISAN (प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि)** योजनेत मिळणारी रक्कम आपल्या जमिनीच्या आकारावर अवलंबून नाही. ही योजना प्रत्येक पात्र शेतकरी कुटुंबाला निश्चित रक्कम देते.

**PM-KISAN योजनेबद्दल महत्वाची माहिती:**

**मुख्य लाभ:**
आपल्याला दरवर्षी **₹६,०००** रुपये मिळतील, जे तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये दिले जातात - प्रत्येक हप्त्यात **₹२,०००** रुपये.

**पात्रता:**
- आपली ०.६८ हेक्टर लागवडीयोग्य जमीन आहे, त्यामुळे आपण या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहात
- शेतकरी कुटुंबामध्ये पती-पत्नी आणि १८ वर्षाखालील मुले यांचा समावेश होतो
- आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत भूधारक शेतकरी कुटुंब पात्र आहेत

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- ७/१२ उतारा (शेतकरी म्हणून नोंदणी)
- आधार जोडलेली असावी
- e-KYC पूर्ण केलेली असावी

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
PM-KISAN च्या अधिकृत वेबसाइटवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करा: **pmkisan.gov.in**

**लक्षात ठेवा:** 
जमिनीचा आकार लहान असो की मोठा, प्रत्येक पात्र शेतकरी कुटुंबाला वर्षाला ₹६,००० मिळतात. ही रक्कम आपल्या बँक खात्यात थेट जमा केली जाते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण या योजनेसाठी आधीच अर्ज केला आहे का? किंवा अर्ज करताना काही मदत हवी आहे का?

question: मी PM-KISAN साठी पात्र आहे का
answer:
आपल्या एग्रिस्टॅक माहितीनुसार, **वाशिम जिल्ह्यातील मालेगाव तालुक्यातील बोर्डी** गावातील शेतकरी म्हणून, आपल्याकडे **0.55 हेक्टर जमीन** आहे. चला आपण **PM-KISAN** योजनेसाठी पात्रता तपासू.

## **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी योजना (PM-KISAN)**

**ही योजना कशासाठी आहे:**
ही योजना शेतजमीन असणाऱ्या शेतकरी कुटुंबांना आर्थिक मदत देण्यासाठी आहे. यामध्ये पती-पत्नी आणि त्यांची १८ वर्षांखालील मुले यांचा समावेश होतो.

**मुख्य फायदे:**
- **₹6,000 प्रतिवर्षी** थेट आपल्या बँक खात्यात
- हा पैसा **तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये** मिळतो (प्रत्येक वेळी ₹2,000)

**पात्रता:**
- आपल्याकडे शेतीयोग्य जमीन असणे आवश्यक आहे ✅
- आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत शेतकरी कुटुंब असणे आवश्यक आहे
- काही अपवर्जन निकष लागू होतात (उच्च पदावरील अधिकारी, मोठे करदाते इत्यादी या योजनेसाठी पात्र नाहीत)

**आपली पात्रता:**
आपल्याकडे **0.55 हेक्टर शेतजमीन** असल्यामुळे, आपण या योजनेच्या मूळ पात्रता पूर्ण करता. तथापि, अंतिम पात्रता यावर अवलंबून असेल:
- आपले नाव ७/१२ उताऱ्यात शेतकरी म्हणून नोंदणीकृत आहे का
- आपले आधार कार्ड बँक खात्याशी जोडलेले आहे का
- आपण e-KYC पूर्ण केले आहे का
- आपण अपवर्जन निकषांमध्ये येत नाही

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- ७/१२ उतारा (जमीन सीडेड)
- आधार कार्ड (बँक खात्याशी जोडलेले)
- e-KYC पूर्ण झाल्याचा पुरावा

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
आपण **pmkisan.gov.in** या संकेतस्थळावर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करू शकता. स्थानिक कॉमन सर्व्हिस सेंटर (CSC) किंवा आपल्या तालुक्यातील कृषी कार्यालयात मदत मिळू शकते.

**पुढील पाऊल:**
जर आपण अजून या योजनेसाठी अर्ज केला नसेल, तर लवकरात लवकर अर्ज करा. जर आपण आधीच अर्ज केला असेल, तर आपण pmkisan.gov.in वर "बेनिफिशियरी स्टेटस" तपासू शकता.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण या योजनेसाठी आधीच अर्ज केला आहे का? किंवा आपल्याला अर्ज प्रक्रियेत काही मदत हवी आहे का?

question: सोयाबीन पिकासाठी PMFBY विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे?
answer:
नमस्कार! मी तुमची प्रोफाईल पाहिली आहे. तुम्ही नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यातील अक्कलकुवा तालुक्यातील नाला गावातील शेतकरी आहात आणि तुमची एकूण जमीन ०.६८ हेक्टर आहे.

**प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)** ही केंद्र शासनाची एक महत्त्वाची विमा योजना आहे जी शेतकऱ्यांना नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड आणि रोगांमुळे होणाऱ्या पीक नुकसानापासून संरक्षण देते.

**सोयाबीन पिकासाठी विमा कव्हरेज:**

**प्रीमियम दर:**
सोयाबीन हे तेलबिया पीक असल्याने **खरीप हंगामात शेतकऱ्यांना फक्त विमा रकमेच्या २% प्रीमियम भरावे लागते**. उर्वरित खर्च केंद्र आणि राज्य शासन समान प्रमाणात (५०:५०) वहन करतात.

**विमा रक्कम प्रति हेक्टर:**
प्रति हेक्टर विमा रक्कम त्या पिकासाठी ठरवलेल्या वित्तीय मानकांनुसार ठरविली जाते.

**क्षतिपूर्ती स्तर:**
योजनेत सर्व अधिसूचित पिकांसाठी **७०% क्षतिपूर्ती स्तर** निश्चित केले आहे. म्हणजेच गेल्या ७ वर्षांपैकी सर्वोत्तम ५ वर्षांच्या सरासरी उत्पादनाच्या ७०% पेक्षा कमी उत्पादन झाल्यास दावा मिळतो.

**कव्हरेज कालावधी:**
योजना पेरणीपूर्व ते कापणीनंतरच्या टप्प्यापर्यंत संरक्षण देते.

**पात्रता:**
- अधिसूचित क्षेत्रातील सर्व शेतकरी (कर्जदार आणि गैर-कर्जदार दोघेही) पात्र आहेत
- हिस्सेदार शेतकरी आणि भाडेकरू शेतकरी सुद्धा पात्र आहेत
- योजना ऐच्छिक आहे

**अर्ज कसा करावा:**
१. www.pmfby.gov.in या संकेतस्थळावर ठरवलेल्या तारखेत ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा
२. आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: अॅग्रीस्टॅक क्रमांक, आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते तपशील, जमीन आणि पीक तपशील, डिजिटल पीक सर्वेक्षण (ई-पिक पहाणी)

तुमच्या ०.६८ हेक्टर जमिनीसाठी सोयाबीन विम्याचा खर्च अगदी कमी असेल. उदाहरणार्थ, जर प्रति हेक्टर विमा रक्कम ₹३०,००० असेल, तर तुम्हाला फक्त ₹४०८ (₹३०,०००  × ०.६८ × २%) च्या सुमारास द्यावे लागतील.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

तुम्ही या वर्षी सोयाबीन लागवड करण्याचा विचार करत आहात का? खरीप हंगामासाठी या योजनेत नोंदणी करण्याची तारीख जाणून घ्यायला मदत करू का?

Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

### 11.2.1 Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), a flagship scheme [योजना] of Ministry of Agriculture [शेती] and Farmers Welfare, launched in 2016 with the objective to protect farmers from crop loss [पीक नुकसान] due to unforeseen natural calamities from pre-sowing [पेरणी] to post harvest [कापणी] and to provide adequate financial support to farmers in the event of loss of crops.

question: कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे
answer:
आपली माहिती मी मिळवली आहे. आपण **नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यातील अक्कलकुवा तालुक्यात नाला गावात** राहता आणि आपल्याकडे **0.68 हेक्टर जमीन** आहे.

**कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS (पुनर्रचित हवामान आधारित पीक विमा योजना) विमा कव्हरेज:**

**RWBCIS योजना** ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे जी २०१६ पासून महाराष्ट्रातील ३० जिल्ह्यांमध्ये म्रुग बहार आणि आंबिया बहार मध्ये राबवली जाते. या योजनेअंतर्गत **फळपीक किंवा बागायती पिकांसाठी** हवामानावर आधारित विमा संरक्षण दिले जाते.

**महत्त्वाची माहिती:**

हे लक्षात घ्यावे की RWBCIS योजना प्रामुख्याने **बागायती पिकांसाठी** (फळे, फुले इत्यादी) असून, **कापूस पिकासाठी** सहसा **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बिमा योजना (PMFBY)** वापरली जाते. PMFBY हि अधिक व्यापक योजना आहे जी धान्य पिके, तेल बियाणे, कापूस आणि इतर पिकांना संरक्षण देते.

**PMFBY अंतर्गत कापूस विमा:**

- **विमा रक्कम:** प्रति हेक्टर वित्त पुरवठा निकषानुसार ठरवली जाते
- **प्रीमियम:** खरीप हंगामासाठी फक्त **2%** (उर्वरित रक्कम केंद्र व राज्य शासन भरते)
- **संरक्षण:** पेरणी पूर्व ते कापणी नंतरच्या नुकसानीसाठी
- **स्वैच्छिक:** कर्जदार आणि बिगरकर्जदार दोन्ही शेतकऱ्यांसाठी
- **नोंदणी:** www.pmfby.gov.in वर ऑनलाईन

**RWBCIS विशेषता** (फळपिकांसाठी):

- जास्त पाऊस, कमी पाऊस, उष्णता, थंडी, गारपीट यांसारख्या प्रतिकूल हवामानामुळे होणाऱ्या नुकसानीसाठी संरक्षण
- महावेध प्रकल्पाच्या हवामान केंद्राच्या डेटावर आधारित दावे
- एका शेतकऱ्याला सर्व अधिसूचित पिकांसाठी ४ हेक्टरपर्यंत नोंदणी करता येते

**आपल्यासाठी सूचना:**

कापूस पिकासाठी **PMFBY योजना** अधिक योग्य आहे. आपल्या जवळच्या कृषी कार्यालयात संपर्क साधून कापूस पिकासाठी विमा योजना आणि प्रीमियम दर, विमा रक्कम आणि नोंदणी प्रक्रियेबद्दल तपशीलवार माहिती घ्यावी.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण या वर्षासाठी कापूस पिकाचा विमा काढण्याचा विचार करत आहात का? मी आपल्याला PMFBY योजनेबद्दल अधिक माहिती देऊ शकतो.

*Scheme Name*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Main Component*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Sub Component*:
Risk cover  against expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm is provided . Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop.

*Introduction*:
1. This  Scheme ( RWBCI) is being implemented since Mrug Bahar 2016 in 30 districts of Maharashtra.It is implemented in Mrug and Ambiya bahar .The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers having orchard of notified crops in the notified area of given productive age are eligible to participate.
2. The Scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee farmers.
3. The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.
4. The claims are decided on weather triggers fixed .  The weather data is taken from  Automatic weather station established under Mahavedh project for the claims calculation.
5. Insurance is provided for expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm.
6. One farmer can enroll for all notified crops upto 4 ha. Including both Mrug and Ambiya bahar.

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to Horticulture farmers in the event of notified crop failure in notified area due to adverse climatic condition .

*Eligibility*:
1. All farmers  growing notified crops of productive age  in the notified area.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date
